FACT: fa_transcribe() FFI bridge returns a plain String — zero timestamp data, not even segment-level
CONTEXT: To add word timestamps for Parakeet, would need:
1. FluidAudioTranscriber Swift package changes to return JSON struct with word timings instead of String
2. C FFI bridge update (currently char* return type)
3. Rust FFI layer parsing of new response format
STATUS: Not implemented, marked as future work
NOTE: Parakeet CTC models do produce frame-level alignments internally — the FluidAudio SDK just doesn't expose them through the current FFI interface
